Loss report: woodpecker -> concourse
[lost] pipeline/woodpecker/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches (the push trigger has no branch filter, and a git resource follows one branch; the resource follows the default branch of the repository)
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker ext.passthrough: git-uri variable (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager)
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker/job/ci/step/publish step.action: plugin image as the task image, entrypoint command as run.path (the entrypoint command comes from pipemaster's plugin table (https://github.com/woodpecker-ci/plugin-docker-buildx/blob/main/Dockerfile); the settings are PLUGIN_ variables in the task params, the Woodpecker convention; the plugin starts a Docker daemon, so the task step sets privileged: true, and the workers must allow privileged tasks)
